messages:
alina: heads up — starting onboarding for gpt-rerank-small-ptq (8-bit PTQ) today. need a concise eval plan for relevance metrics and gating. :eyes:
marc: +1 on plan. we should compare ndcg@1/3/10 and mrr across train/val/test and an OOD holdout. also log per-query delta distributions, not just averages.
jsantos: agree. prefer bootstrap CI over single p-values for ndcg. simple script idea:
```
# bootstrap ndcg diff
python -m eval.bootstrap --preds a.json b.json --metric ndcg@10 --iters 1000
```
this gives a 95% CI on the delta.
priya: for release gating propose thresholds: ndcg@10 drop <= 0.5% tolerated, between 0.5-1.5% blocked for canary, >1.5% auto-block. mrr similar but looser: <=1% ok. need to sync with product.
ben: quick note: quantized runs sometimes change tokenization boundary behavior for long docs. recommend standardized doc cropping to 512 tokens and two-format eval: full-doc and cropped-first-512. call out when metric flips only on full-doc.
sofia: we should wire this into CI canary. suggest a canary job config snippet for the pipeline:
```
jobs:
  canary_rerank_eval:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: python eval/run_suite.py --suite rerank_canary --model gpt-rerank-small-ptq
```
and fail the pipeline only if bootstrap CI excludes zero and magnitude > threshold.
alina: good. dataset selection — we'll use ms-marco dev, a Redwood internal high-recall set (redwood-qrels-2025), and a synthetic query-paraphrase slice for robustness. marc, can you assemble the 3 splits?
marc: on it. I'll export: msmarco_dev.json, redwood_qrels_2025.json, paraphrase_slice.json. adding stratified buckets by query length and answer type.
jsantos: small suggestion: include a longitudinal view per-model-variant (fp16 vs ptq vs ptq+kl-finetune) and plot per-query scatter of fp16_score vs ptq_score, mark points with abs(delta) > 0.02. that's how we spot concentrated regressions.
ben: FYI ran a local quick eval on subset (5k queries) — numbers: fp16 ndcg@10=0.351, ptq ndcg@10=0.347 => delta -0.004 (CI [-0.007, -0.001]). looks small but some queries drop a lot. saving top-50 worst queries in gist.
alina: can you post the gist? want examples for SRE/SEV triage.
ben: here: https://gist.github.com/ben/ptq-worst-50 (includes query, top2 docs fp16 vs ptq).
priya: also add evaluation by query intent slice (navigational, transactional, informational). regressions concentrated on navigational could be higher priority.
sofia: adding canary workflow to infra backlog ticket INFRA-1147. will notify ops once job lands.
eval-bot: automated run finished: suite rerank_canary on gpt-rerank-small-ptq -> ndcg@10 delta vs baseline (fp16): -0.38% (bootstrap 95% CI -0.65% to -0.12%), mrr delta -0.9% (CI -1.6% to -0.2%). canary status: review-required. :warning:
alina: thanks eval-bot. that matches local. next steps: marc/priya analyze worst-query slices, jsantos run bootstrap significance on full holdout, sofia schedule canary window. I'll compile a short postmortem-style note if we gate.
marc: will run per-intent breakdown and produce CSVs. target by EOD PST.
jsantos: running full bootstrap now (1000 iters). will ping when CI artifact is ready.
priya: I'll draft proposed rollback policy and communication for product/customer teams — keep it simple: soft-gate (canary) for <1.5% ndcg drop, hard rollback for >2.5% or customer-facing regressions.
alina: perfect. thanks all — let's reconvene after artifacts. :thumbsup:
